summary: Comprehensive testing of Staple Items (Sonstige Artikel) feature for German Meal Planner. All CRUD operations work correctly. Shopping list integration works - staple items appear in a separate 'Sonstige Artikel' section. Fixed a bug where shopping list didn't return staple_items when no meal plan existed.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - React hydration warning from select element rendering. Minor issue, doesn't affect functionality.

passed_tests: GET /api/staple-items returns items list and categories array
POST /api/staple-items creates new staple item with name, amount, unit, category
PUT /api/staple-items/{id} updates existing item (name, amount, unit, category)
GET /api/shopping-list includes staple_items array alongside recipe items
Only active staple items appear in shopping list
Deactivating a staple item removes it from shopping list
Staple items in shopping list have correct structure (item_id, ingredient_name, total_amount, unit, category, is_staple)
StapleItems page renders at /staple-items with categories, items, and add button
Adding a new staple item via form works and shows in list
Editing an existing staple item updates correctly
Deleting a staple item removes it from list
Category filter buttons work on staple items page
Toggle active switch works on staple items
Shopping list page shows both 'Rezept-Zutaten' and 'Sonstige Artikel' sections
'Verwalten' link on shopping list navigates to /staple-items
Navigation sidebar includes 'Sonstige Artikel' link with Package icon

bug_fixed.description: Shopping list endpoint returned empty response without staple_items when no meal plan existed for the week
bug_fixed.fix: Added staple items query to the early return path when no meal plan exists

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React hydration warning in StapleItems.jsx select element - the <span> wrapper inside <option> causes console warning. Consider using native select without wrapper spans.
seed_data_creation: Existing staple items: Mineralwasser (6 Flasche, Getränke), Küchentücher (1 Rolle, Haushalt), Olivenöl (0.5 Liter, Gewürze). Test items created and cleaned up during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staple Items feature is fully implemented and tested. Backend CRUD endpoints at /api/staple-items work correctly. Shopping list at /api/shopping-list now returns {items: [...recipe items], staple_items: [...active staple items], week_start: str}. Frontend pages: /staple-items for management, /shopping-list shows both sections. Categories: Getränke, Gewürze, Haushalt, Hygiene, Backzutaten, Sonstiges. Units: Stück, Packung, Flasche, Liter, ml, kg, g, Dose, Beutel, Rolle, Tube.

backend_endpoints.POST /api/staple-items: Creates item with name, amount, unit, category, active

staple_items_feature_details.shopping_list_integration: Active staple items automatically appear in shopping list under 'Sonstige Artikel' section

frontend_pages./staple-items: Management page with CRUD operations, category filters, active toggles
frontend_pages./shopping-list: Shows both recipe ingredients and staple items with 'Verwalten' link

staple_items_feature_details.navigation: Sidebar includes 'Sonstige Artikel' link with Package icon
